channels.title: Channels shoppers can choose
channels.description: Delivered through the merchant's own messaging connector.

require_consent.title: Require the consent checkbox
require_consent.description: Browser sign-ups must tick the consent text (strings: capture.consent.*); the text version is stored with the subscription.

double_opt_in.title: Double opt-in
double_opt_in.description: Send a confirmation message first; the subscription becomes active only after the link is confirmed.

allow_contact_entry.title: Guests may type an e-mail or phone
allow_contact_entry.description: Off: only customers signed in on the website (bring-your-own identity) can subscribe, with the address from their login.

prefer_identity_contact.title: Use the signed-in customer's address
prefer_identity_contact.description: When the login carries an e-mail / phone, use it instead of a typed one.

refuse_when_available.title: Refuse back-in-stock sign-ups for available items

item_url_policy.title: Item links accepted from the page
item_url_policy.description: same_site: only links on the website's domain; any_https: any https link; none: never.

default_lang.title: Default language
default_lang.description: Language of alerts when the shopper's is unknown (BCP 47).

max_per_ip_per_hour.title: Sign-ups per visitor IP per hour

max_per_contact_per_day.title: Sign-ups per contact or customer per day
